create_ros_camera: create a RosCamera instance from a ROS topic with optional rotation and buffer size
get_camera_image: get the latest image from a RosCamera as a numpy array or PyTorch tensor
get_filtered_image: get a smoothed image from the camera buffer using mean and standard deviation filtering
get_camera_intrinsics: get the camera intrinsic matrix K or full camera info including distortion and projection matrices
filter_valid_point_cloud: filter a point cloud to keep only valid pixels within near and far depth bounds
